alignments.note: Waw takes *And*.
Subject noun rendered *fire*.

`יָצָא` rendered by the perfect *is gone out*, with *out* the verb's own phrasal particle; head on the lexical verb (rule 44). The competing reading gives *out of* to `מִן` as rule 24's *out of* and leaves the verb *is gone*; I took the division that keeps the verb's ordinary English phrase whole.
`מִן` rendered *of* here, the verb having taken *out* (see the preceding unit).
Construct noun with no article morpheme present takes the supplied *the* (rule 29); the ASV's plural *rods* renders the collective.
Nomen rectum takes the relational *of* (rule 19); discontinuous around the possessive (rule 25).
Suffix takes the possessive *its* (rule 18).
Finite verb with subject pronoun and auxiliary; head on the lexical verb.
Suffix takes the possessive *its* (rule 18).
Construct noun keeps its own word.

The ASV recasts this waw's clause as a result clause and writes coordinator and subordinator together at its left edge, so *so that* is the waw's one rendering, headed on the coordinator (rule 55). The competing reading heads it on *that*.
Existential `הָיָה` with its dummy subject, which belongs to the verb's unit (rule 21); head on the verb's own word.
Preposition rendered *in*.
Suffix takes the pronoun *it* (rule 18).
Negative takes the *no* the ASV writes for it.
The construct relation is rendered attributively, so `עֹז` takes *strong* (rule 28).
Construct noun rendered *rod*.

Predicative nominal; the construction-supplied copula *to be* joins the predicate it completes (rule 20) and the indefinite article belongs to the noun (rule 15). Head on the noun carrying the lexeme.
`לְ` before the infinitive construct takes *to*.
Infinitive construct rendered *rule*.
Explicit subject pronoun rendered by the demonstrative *This*; it takes only its own word, the copula going to the predicate (rule 20).
Predicate of the verbless clause, so the supplied copula joins it (rule 20); the indefinite article belongs to the noun (rule 15).
Waw takes *and*.
`הָיָה` rendered by the future copula *shall be*; head on the verb's own word.
Resultative `לְ` takes the *for* the ASV writes for it (rules 11, 49).
Indefinite article belongs to the noun (rule 15).
